name: Omniscient Geometric Satellite Integrity (GPS)
description: The grim reaper of Spatial Metadata. A malicious fraudster might seamlessly composite two images—stitching a politician vacationing in Hawaii directly into a terrorist incident in Moscow's Red Square. Human eyes may be wildly deceived, but the embedded GPS telemetry (Geographical coordinates locked within the EXIF) never lies. Furthermore, to cement authenticity, physical GPS data firmly binds to orbital solar logic. By dissecting this relationship, the engine physically eviscerates the fraudster's geographical camouflage.
algorithm: Global Geolocation Correlation & Solar Ephemeris Tracking Vector
mechanism: Abandoning subjective RGB pixel colors entirely, the matrix dives straight into the HEX core, extracting Longitude, Latitude, and Timestamp (capture hour). Armed with Time and Space, the algorithm instantly simulates the authentic real-world position and altitude of the Physical Sun (Solar Elevation Angle). It cross-interrogates this with the image content: Does the estimated drop-shadow cast by subjects point in the exact opposite direction of mathematical solar reality? -> An idiotic splice. Or severely: Does the image completely lack GPS tags despite originating from an apparent premium device? -> An immediate red-flag for forensic data scrubbing (AI/Photoshop laundering).
parameters: Munitions: EXIF GPSVersionID / Latitude_Ref Sweeper, Simulation Engine: Solar Ephemeris Trigonometry & Crossover Shadow Cast
accuracy: Absolute Execution (98-100% Angular Correlation) - An immediate arrest warrant is issued the exact millisecond the satellite vector and pixel shadows misalign.
source: Photonic Weather & Camera Telemetry Correlation Forensic Archives
useCase: Rains absolute hellfire down upon multi-billion-dollar fake news campaigns (e.g., falsely compositing a Head of State into a scandalous location). Unless the physical Sun shatters the Moon, the drop shadows in a photograph cannot inherently defy satellite orbital mathematics.

references.title: Kee, E., et al. (2013). Exposing photo manipulation from shading and shadows. ACM TOG.
JEITA CP-3451C — Exif 2.32 GPS IFD Specification
EXIF GPS Data Format — ExifTool Documentation

strengths:
• Absolute iron-clad evidence in legal proceedings. Solar physics are an unalterable constant. Fraudsters attempting to manually paint correct drop shadows across distinct global timezones routinely fail; even a minor angular deviation triggers the guillotine.
• Utterly unrelenting. Clumsy perpetrators either blatantly scrub the telemetry completely, or hallucinate a Hawaiian tag onto an obviously snowy Himalayan mountain... volunteering their own head to the chopping block.
limitations:
• The executioner's bullets spectacularly miss if the image is captured deep indoors (a Studio environment entirely lacking a singular sun). Satellite modeling and shadow extrapolation become completely blinded and useless.
• Catastrophically disarmed against social media laundering. Facebook/WhatsApp intentionally nuke 100% of GPS wrappers to mask user locations, neutralizing the radar by drowning it in wiped coordinates.
